spans.s: laggati (= Pali id., BHS lagnati, q.v.), sticks, clings: Mv 〔ii.429.13〕 (v.l. lagneti).

lagnati, lagneti? (also laggati, q.v.; and anulagnati, vilagnita; = Pali laggati, Pkt. laggai, acc. to Geiger 〔136.2〕 and Pischel 〔488〕 from Skt. *lagyati; but see 〔§ 28.19〕), sticks, clings: ˚nati Mv 〔iii.148.2〕 (twice); impv. ˚natha Mv 〔iii.354.10〕; opt. ˚neyaṃ Mv 〔iii.128.3〕. In Mv 〔ii.429.13〕 lagneti is v.l. for laggati, q.v., of text.
